description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for the 'to_charset' modifier, which converts character encoding from the internal charset to a specified charset using 'mb_convert_encoding'. It defines a single function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_to_charset' that generates the code for the modifier.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_to_charset
methods.description: Generates PHP code to convert string encoding using mb_convert_encoding, based on provided parameters and internal charset.
